description: Central fine-tuning parameters for the unsignalised right-hand traffic give-way experiment. Scenario JSON keeps the route and traffic semantics; this file owns numeric parameters that may change between CARLA trials.

tuning_rationale.collision_d_min: Minimum additional clearance around the configured collision ellipse. Current value keeps the 20260619_203644 no-footprint-collision behavior while avoiding the overly conservative d_min=1.0/1.5 failures.
tuning_rationale.collision_ellipse_half_length: Ellipse half-length used by SMPC chance constraints; must cover the CARLA-like vehicle footprint plus margin.
tuning_rationale.collision_ellipse_half_width: Ellipse half-width used by SMPC chance constraints; must cover the CARLA-like vehicle footprint plus margin.
tuning_rationale.reference_regen_max_lateral_error: Guard for regenerating the local reference. After 2.5/4.0 allowed unsafe conflict-zone behavior in CARLA, the safety-first setting returns to the conservative 1.5m guard.
tuning_rationale.yield_stop_enabled: Enables the rule-aware yielding state machine for the turning ego vehicle. Full priority yielding still requires a valid multimodal prediction, while an observed moving target track may trigger a conservative cautious-approach phase before prediction is ready.
tuning_rationale.yield_stop_speed: Near-stop target speed used by the control override at the yield line.
tuning_rationale.yield_caution_speed: Rolling speed target used when a priority target is observed but is not yet close enough to require a full hard stop. Reduced after 20260705_174648 because the 4.5m/s rolling phase left the ego near 8m/s when hard-stop yielding began.
tuning_rationale.yield_creep_speed: Low rolling speed used near the route-defined yield line before hard-stop conditions are met. It lets the ego continue creeping toward a safer waiting pose instead of stopping far upstream.
tuning_rationale.yield_caution_decel: Comfort-oriented deceleration limit for rolling caution/creep phases. Kept at the 20260706_000724 milestone value because the stronger -4.5m/s^2 follow-up reduced footprint safety margin without moving the final stopped pose closer.
tuning_rationale.yield_reference_min_speed: Minimum speed used only by the pre-solve optimisation reference during hold_yield_line. The 0.8m/s value is restored because the 1.0m/s trial did not reduce var-risk failures and worsened fixed-risk hold failures; the control override still performs the final near-stop behaviour at yield_stop_speed.
tuning_rationale.yield_reference_decel: Maximum deceleration used only by the pre-solve optimisation reference profile. It remains softer than yield_stop_decel so the optimiser sees a smoother speed cap before the final control override handles near-stop braking. Kept at the 20260706_000724 milestone value after the stronger -4.25m/s^2 follow-up did not improve the final stopped pose.
tuning_rationale.yield_stop_decel: Maximum desired deceleration applied by the rule-aware yielding controller. The value is set to -5.0m/s^2 so ego_init_01 can physically brake from the initial approach speed before the route-defined stop point.
tuning_rationale.yield_emergency_brake_enabled: Enables a bounded safety fallback only during active yield when the priority target has not cleared and the nominal braking-distance trigger is already active. It is intended for the original high-speed paper ego_init_01 case, where ordinary -5.0m/s^2 yielding still slid into the conflict zone.
tuning_rationale.yield_emergency_decel: Strongest desired deceleration for emergency yield braking. Set to -7.0m/s^2 after the neutral-steering trial passed safety but produced an unnatural pre-conflict straight hold. The ego now keeps route-following left-turn steering while relying on stronger braking to avoid front-footprint intrusion.
tuning_rationale.yield_emergency_jerk_limit: Maximum rate at which the emergency yield controller may increase braking demand, in m/s^3. Set to 10.0m/s^3 as a middle ground between the earlier abrupt 15.0m/s^3 trial and the too-weak 8.0m/s^3 route-steering trial.
tuning_rationale.yield_emergency_conflict_margin: Extra margin beyond yield_conflict_radius used only for debug/reproducibility of the emergency safe conflict boundary. It records whether the vehicle is still outside the conflict-boundary-safe stop target while emergency braking is active.
tuning_rationale.yield_hard_stop_target_distance: Target-distance threshold for switching from rolling caution/creep to hard-stop yielding. Set to 11.5m after the TV=9.0m/s, conflict-distance=13.0m trial showed hard-stop was still triggered by target proximity at target dconf≈11.6-11.8m and released upstream at dconf≈7.32m. This is a conservative midpoint between the stable 12.0m setting and the rejected 10.5m TV=10.0m/s trial that introduced non-zero solver failures.
tuning_rationale.yield_hard_stop_conflict_distance: Ego distance-to-conflict threshold that forces hard-stop yielding even if the target-distance threshold has not yet triggered. Set to 13.0m as a small reduction from the 20260706_000724 stable 13.5m value, using the no-solver-failure TV=8.0m/s trial as the closest validated lower bound.
tuning_rationale.yield_conflict_radius: Radius around the fixed conflict point defined by the ego route and target current/predicted straight motion line.
tuning_rationale.yield_stop_buffer_distance: Distance before the fixed conflict point where the ego must wait while the straight-going target has priority. Restored to 7.0m after 20260705_215601 showed that increasing it to 9.0m did not move the actual stopped pose away from dconf≈4.24m and instead worsened yield order. The remaining issue is the hard-stop steering pose, not a farther upstream stop-line target.
tuning_rationale.yield_footprint_clearance_margin: Additional footprint-aware clearance beyond yield_conflict_radius. Added after 20260705_203724, where center-circle yield order could pass while the CARLA footprint replay still overlapped the straight target path. This margin is used for target release clearance and emergency safe-stop diagnostics without moving the configured route stop line.
tuning_rationale.yield_brake_distance_margin: Additional safety margin added to v^2/(2|a_min|) so yield activates before the ego reaches the physical braking limit for the stop point. Restored to 3.5m after 20260705_224207 passed safety but stopped too far upstream at dconf≈8.39m. Strong emergency braking is kept, but the trigger margin is reduced so the ego can stop closer while still following the natural left-turn route.
tuning_rationale.yield_wait_steer_lookahead_distance: Route lookahead from the stop point used to keep the ego aligned with the intended left turn while waiting.
tuning_rationale.yield_wait_steer_gain: Gain applied to the route-defined waiting steering command.
tuning_rationale.yield_ttc_margin: Time margin for deciding whether ego and target would overlap in the conflict zone.
tuning_rationale.yield_activation_distance: Maximum ego path distance to the conflict point at which the supervisor may activate. The value is tightened so the ego can roll forward initially before meeting the conflict-zone yield condition.
tuning_rationale.yield_hold_distance: Distance to the route-defined stop point where the ego switches from approach_yield_line to hold_yield_line.
tuning_rationale.yield_release_time: Minimum predicted target-clearance time needed before releasing the near-stop hold.
tuning_rationale.yield_release_clearance_margin: Extra target clearance beyond yield_conflict_radius required before starting released_recovery. The 1.0m buffer is added after 20260627_203901, where fixed-risk had zero solver failures and correct yield order but a 0.15s footprint overlap immediately after the target crossed the nominal conflict-radius boundary.
tuning_rationale.yield_observed_caution_enabled: Enables a non-oracle cautious approach before MultiPath prediction is valid. It uses only observed target positions across frames to estimate a target motion line.
tuning_rationale.yield_observed_caution_distance: Maximum ego path distance to the conflict point at which an observed moving target can trigger cautious approach while prediction is not yet valid. Observed caution may also trigger earlier when the current speed already requires braking distance to reach the route-defined stop point; this keeps high-speed paper initial conditions from waiting until the fixed conflict-distance window.
tuning_rationale.yield_observed_caution_min_target_speed: Minimum observed target speed needed to form an observed-track motion line for cautious approach.
tuning_rationale.yield_steer_damping: Steering damping factor applied while near-stopped so the ego does not keep turning sharply during the yield hold.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_enabled: Enables the released_recovery phase after the straight-going target has cleared the conflict zone.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_steps: Maximum number of controller steps in which the ego may recover from yielding. This is now fixed as the accepted post-turn solution after 20260705_174648: the extended recovery kept lane-entry speed around 5m/s and lateral error close to zero.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_regen_period: Reference regeneration period during post-yield recovery. A shorter period helps the ego rebuild a feasible local reference after stopping.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_max_lateral_error: Temporary lateral-error guard used only after a completed yield, preventing stale-reference lock while still bounding recovery reference generation.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_speed: Maximum desired speed during post-yield recovery. Fixed as part of the accepted post-turn solution so the ego accelerates through the turn and lane-entry segment instead of crawling after the target clears.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_accel: Upper bound on desired acceleration during post-yield recovery. Fixed as part of the accepted post-turn solution to produce gradual acceleration after yielding without jumping to full throttle.
tuning_rationale.nominal_speed: Nominal unobstructed speed. The ego is allowed to slow down or nearly stop to yield to the straight-going target. For the target role this trial uses 9.0m/s while retaining the 20260706_000724 stable yield parameters; the upstream scenario_01 used a faster target (nominal 10.0m/s, init 12.0m/s), while this adapted right-hand-traffic scenario keeps target init speed equal to nominal speed for a controlled straight-target trial.
